Unless I'm mistaken, insider trading is not protected under the Presidential immunity decision from the SCOTUS. Ordinary people can buy and sell shares, so even if the President is doing it, it does not fall under the protected category of official acts, otherwise describes as actions within the exclusive sphere of Executive powers. Executive orders are covered, as is hiring and firing for the most part, because he alone can do those things as President.
